_readme: T0a baseline for tests/timetable-callers-pin.spec.ts (my-timetable-responsive-prompt T15). Captured 2026-11-15 on the testing DB (class_replacement_testing, :8030) and on the served ui-common.js BEFORE any change of this lane. 'synthetic' = buildTimetableGrid() called with the fixed SYNTH_EVENTS array on /login (plain, non-cellRender mode + the cohort page's tipLecturerFn/statusClassFn shapes) — the branch where T12's two flag-only edits land. 'cohort'/'venue' = the live #timetable outerHTML, fixed weeks (cohort week 9, venue B005 week 9), for the `.tt-responsive`-absent identity: those pages never pass the responsive flag. The Arrangement page needs a course picked before it paints a grid, so its identity is covered by the synthetic call (same function, same flags) and by the two live pages, not by a third live capture — recorded in the apply log.
